Name: CS_REFLECTION_QUALITY_DETAIL
Description: Reflection settings for each level of the Reflection Quality option. Loaded from the system params, not regulation.bin. The whole param is ignored if its data version is not 1.

Fields.Name: Reflections Enabled
Fields.Description: Turns reflections on for this level.

Fields.Name: Local Lights in Reflections
Fields.Description: Lets local (point and spot) lights appear in reflections.

Fields.Name: Force Local Lights in Reflections
Fields.Description: On: local lights are always included in reflections, whatever Local Lights in Reflections is set to.

Fields.Name: SSR Gaussian Blur Enabled
Fields.Description: Allows the Gaussian blur pass on screen-space reflections.

Fields.Name: SSR Depth Reject Scale
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the screen-space reflection depth-reject threshold.

Fields.Name: SSR Ray Step Scale
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the screen-space reflection ray step; larger steps are cheaper but coarser.

Fields.Name: SSR Fade Angle Bias
Fields.Description: Bias on the fade of reflections that face the camera; smaller is higher quality.

Fields.Name: SSR Fresnel Reject Bias
Fields.Description: Bias on the Fresnel-based rejection of reflections; smaller is higher quality.
